changes.before: whole-clip displacement divided by clip duration
changes.after: body-scale-normalized displacement divided by active locomotion time
changes.reason: remove sitting and static duration from gait speed

changes.before: fixed 1.0 reference could produce relative-speed Evidence
changes.after: same resident/device/camera/source personal median plus status-specific MAD noise floor; no Evidence when baseline is insufficient
changes.reason: make the claimed personal baseline real and auditable

changes.before: rise speed and gait observations could enter broad precursor scoring
changes.after: ORANGE uses trunk/translation/feet only; speed and gait deviations are trend-only
changes.reason: prevent rapid or slow rise from being treated as immediate instability

changes.before: threshold crossing could yield near-saturated severity
changes.after: severity is normalized excess between threshold and a declared saturation value
changes.reason: preserve separation near the decision boundary

changes.before: single-pose extraction and environmental risk weighting
changes.after: two-pose extraction plus tracking/occlusion, feet-in-frame, low-light and multi-person degradation
changes.reason: return indeterminate results for unassessable video instead of risk classification

changes.before: indeterminate post-rise geometry discarded a valid standalone walking window
changes.after: GAIT_ONLY suppresses immediate post-rise signals while retaining valid gait trend features
changes.reason: separate post-rise assessability from gait-window assessability

changes.after: 30-day window, 3-day provisional, 7-day stable, separately grouped compliant replay/live sources and SHA-256 deduplication
changes.reason: support auditable real-device baselines without mixing provenance

changes.before: forewarning multi-signal bonus counted distinct Evidence types
changes.after: state machine and forewarning both count trunk/translation/feet families from ruleset-v1.4
changes.reason: two feet Evidence types must not masquerade as two independent instability families

freeze_policy: No threshold or label changes after supplemental TEST output is inspected.
